$comment: The Store desktops' wallpapers: illustrations by other people, free to use (each entry names its licence). The files are not in the repository: node store/wallpapers.mjs fetches each from its source and fits it to 3840 x 2160 under store/wallpapers/ (git-ignored). The owner chose these eleven on 2026-11-12.

wallpapers.name: beach-sunset
wallpapers.author: karem adem
wallpapers.shows: Glowing sun over a curving beach and banded peach/teal headlands; rich textures, warm, mid-light.

wallpapers.name: cactus-island
wallpapers.author: WILLIAN REIS
wallpapers.shows: Rocky island of tall cacti on a white salt flat under a blue sky with clouds, distant blue peaks; detailed, bright daylight. Light.

wallpapers.name: desert-arch
wallpapers.author: Alghozy
wallpapers.shows: Cave frame onto a red stone arch, blue sky and snowy peaks, tiny hiker on the arch; vivid daylight, dark edges. Mid.

wallpapers.name: desert-cave
wallpapers.author: Alghozy
wallpapers.shows: Looking out of a dark cave mouth onto a sunlit desert canyon, tiny figure in the opening; dark frame, warm centre. Dark.

wallpapers.name: golden-dunes
wallpapers.author: Balaji Krishnamurty
wallpapers.shows: Stylised ochre and cream sand dunes, no sky detail; warm, light-mid.

wallpapers.name: night-trees
wallpapers.author: saatvik 5554
wallpapers.shows: Black tree silhouettes left and right, big orange moon, starry violet sky; dark night (busy at the edges).

wallpapers.name: pale-dunes
wallpapers.author: Alghozy
wallpapers.shows: Coral-peach dune sea with a footprint trail along a ridge, pale off-white sky; bright, warm. Light.

wallpapers.name: red-canyon
wallpapers.author: Alghozy
wallpapers.shows: Red-rock canyon walls framing a pale-blue sky, sage shrubs in front; bright daylight, warm terracotta; same hand as liked 24. Light.

wallpapers.name: red-desert-dusk
wallpapers.author: GDJ
wallpapers.shows: Flat parallax desert at dusk: red/pink mesas, big sun rings, cactus silhouettes; vivid warm, dark base. Mid-dark.

wallpapers.name: tropical-bay
wallpapers.author: Alghozy
wallpapers.shows: Turquoise bay with sandy beach seen past green headlands; light daylight coast (busy lower-left).

wallpapers.name: warm-mountains
wallpapers.author: Anna Magenta
wallpapers.shows: Terracotta/orange layered mountains with leafy foliage in the bottom corners; warm, mid-light.
